Everyone critiques LLM “slop”. Fewer ask where it comes from: the model—or the human asking for it?

Vague intent, no canonical source, blurred ownership and missing review do not disappear inside an LLM. They become faster, polished and distributed at scale.
Without a solid runtime, clear guidelines/QMS, ownership and evidence, an LLM amplifies the slop already in the system.
Build the discipline first. Then AI becomes a force multiplier for work you can stand behind.

#AIEngineering #AgenticAI
